items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewee only says 'Humphrey.' The mention of Donnie is made by the Interviewer ('Donnie used to play with him'), not the interviewee.

ctx.x: Humphrey. Humphrey. Humphrey. Humphrey. Well, he's still playing. Well, Donnie used to play with him. And George. George used to play with him too. But George was his right hand.
